module_summary: Synchronous FIFO: 8-entry register array with wrapping write/read pointers and an occupancy counter generating valid/ready handshakes, plus synchronous flush.

anchors.name: mem_q
anchors.why: FIFO data array written at wptr_q on push, read at rptr_q.

anchors.name: wptr_q
anchors.why: Write pointer addressing mem_q, increments on push, cleared by flush.

anchors.name: rptr_q
anchors.why: Read pointer selecting out_data entry, increments on pop.

anchors.name: count_q
anchors.why: Occupancy count; derives in_ready (not full) and out_valid (not empty).

anchors.name: in_valid
anchors.why: Write-side valid; push when combined with in_ready.

anchors.name: in_ready
anchors.why: Write-side ready, high while FIFO is not full.

anchors.name: in_data
anchors.why: Write data stored into mem_q on push.

anchors.name: out_valid
anchors.why: Read-side valid, high while FIFO is not empty.

anchors.name: out_ready
anchors.why: Read-side ready from consumer; pop when with out_valid.

anchors.name: out_data
anchors.why: Head-of-FIFO data read from mem_q at rptr_q.

anchors.name: flush_i
anchors.why: Flush request clearing pointers and count.

anchors.name: do_push
anchors.why: Write enable for mem_q, wptr_q advance and count increment.

anchors.name: do_pop
anchors.why: Pop enable advancing rptr_q and decrementing count.

groups.name: pointer_control
groups.description: Write/read pointers, occupancy count, push/pop enables and flush.
